notes.title: Ramshackle.EXE Progress
notes.content:
[p]Good morning, good night and everything in between. 

Where does the time go? It’s been just over a year since the last news post so here is a progress update. Development of Ramshackle.EXE is going steady and will maybe get a release date soonish. Reaching that light at the end of the tunnel is becoming more believable each day but I dare not tempt fate.

As progress goes, the bulk of the game is effectively done, it's now just the ever increasing chaos of testing, feedback and hopefully, improvements. It's certainly a remarkable thing testing "fun" as there doesn't seem to be a definitive answer of when enough "fun" has been achieved.

Also I've made a new Ramshackle.EXE trailer, I hope you like it. It was created for "THIS is E3 2025" from The Infinite Review YouTube channel. If you ever wanted anything and everything in the universe reviewed, that channel will be right up your alley.

All in all, I'm still trudging along. Now where has that time gone?

- Arkwright.EXE  [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_2rzti5wTcw"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest 2nd Livestream
notes.content:
The 2nd livestream for Ramshackle.EXE will be on June 14th at 10:00 PM BST. Once again, if you have any questions I will be there in chat to answer them. It'll be like the cinema, expect the usher made the film and joins in on the conversation.

- Arkwright.EXE

notes.title: Ramshackle.EXE at Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Ramshackle.EXE will be particiapating in Steam Next Fest this year on June 10th.

For the event, Ramshackle.EXE will be releasing a playable demo which will remain available even after the event is over. The demo contains two levels, the first boss fight and two unlockable FailSafe (Time Attack) stages for players who 100% each normal level. 

I hope you enjoy the demo but even if you don't, thank you for giving the game a chance considering the gargantuan amount of other games out there.

After playing the demo, it would be wonderful if you could post feedback or suggestions in the Steam Community page for Ramshackle.EXE. 

In addition to the demo, Ramshackle.EXE will also have two livestreams during the event. They are at June 10th at 10:00 PM BST and June 14th at 10:00 PM BST. If you have any questions, I will be there in chat trying to think up a witty but falling short answer to them.

- Arkwright.EXE
